description: Add new campaigns. Pass a JSON array of campaign objects. Each must include Name and a campaign-type-specific settings object (e.g. TextCampaign, DynamicTextCampaign). Use when the user asks to create new campaigns. Do not use it to change an existing campaign; call update_campaigns, which overwrites values and requires confirm. Do not use it to list campaigns; call get_campaigns.

items_json.description: JSON array of campaign objects, e.g. [{"Name":"My Campaign","StartDate":"2024-01-01","TextCampaign":{"BiddingStrategy":{"Search":{"BiddingStrategyType":"WB_MAXIMUM_CLICKS","WbMaximumClicks":{"WeeklySpendLimit":300000000}},"Network":{"BiddingStrategyType":"SERVING_OFF"}}}}]

name: add_campaigns
